bullets.text: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi highlighted that the AI boom will drive demand for clean and affordable power, and the office should monitor energy requirements for digital growth.
Chief Justice of India Justice Surya Kant inaugurated a new data centre at the Jharkhand High Court, and the office should watch judicial infrastructure tech advancements.

stories.title: AI boom to drive demand for clean, affordable power: Pralhad Joshi
takeaways: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi highlighted that the AI boom will drive demand for clean power.
Ensuring affordable and clean electricity access remains critical for rising artificial intelligence adoption.
stories.snippet: AI boom to drive demand for clean, affordable power: Pralhad Joshi Synopsis Union Minister Pralhad Joshi highlighted the importance of affordable, clean electricity access amid rising artificial intelligence adoption.…

stories.title: Chief Justice of India CJI Surya Kant inaugurates data centre at Jharkhand High Court
takeaways: Chief Justice of India CJI Surya Kant inaugurated a state-of-the-art data centre at Jharkhand High Court.
The facility in Ranchi aims to enhance the technological capabilities of the judicial infrastructure.
stories.snippet: Chief Justice of India CJI Surya Kant inaugurates data centre at Jharkhand High Court The Chief Justice of India (CJI), Justice Surya Kant, inaugurated a state-of-the-art Data Centre at the Jharkhand High Court, Ranchi.…
